answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 32 confirmed judged findings (the three tool findings F-0001, F-0018 and F-0019 are left out), 22 map to seeded defects, 6 are real but not seeded and 4 are not a problem: precision = 28/32 = 0.875. Strict precision is 22/32 = 0.69. Recall by meaning is 13/14 (D01-D12 and D14; D02 is covered only by the tool finding F-0019, and nothing covers D13, the 20-minute length that only the tooltip gives), or 12/14 for judged findings alone.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply opens with a numbered 'Fix first (could lose people their slot or get them turned away at the gate)' list (double-tap cancel, permit, done page, hold, past slots), then 'Accessibility failures (WCAG 2.2 AA blockers)', then the scope decision. It also says what needs a person: 'Whether this fails WCAG 2.2.1 needs a person to decide', plus a 'Not covered' list (real phone screen readers, real large-text settings, an exact measure of the hold time, CJK input, real residents).

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px from the slot grid
mapping.reason: The slot area runs 15 px past a 320 px viewport, so the page scrolls sideways. This is the seeded grid overflow at 360 px and below.

mapping.title: '20 slots free' status message not announced
mapping.reason: The live region is created together with the count text, so screen readers never hear how many slots the day has. This is exactly D11.

mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot buttons
mapping.reason: Tab focus on the '08:00' slot changes no pixels, so keyboard users cannot see where they are. This is the seeded missing focus ring on slot buttons.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps back to '08:20 Few left'
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' slots are moved visually but not in the DOM, so Tab order and reading order no longer match the grid. The instructions put focus jumping around the grid under D10.

mapping.title: Cancelled booking page still headed 'Booked' with gate instructions
mapping.reason: D09's harm includes the done page after an accidental cancel: it is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate', with only a small cancelled line. This item describes that same misleading outcome.

mapping.title: Expired-hold error has no way forward and blanks the slot
mapping.reason: This is the lapsed five-minute hold: Book says 'This slot is no longer available.' and the slot row turns to a dash, dropping the slot without saying why. Both are in D08.

mapping.title: Slot hold is a hidden time limit
mapping.reason: No page states the hold's length, shows time remaining or warns before it ends. That is D08, the hold running out unseen.

mapping.title: Booked page omits day, time and vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page shows only the reference and gate instructions, not the day, the slot or the vehicle. That is exactly D14.

mapping.title: No loading state while a day's slots are fetched
mapping.reason: The Slots section is blank for about a second with no loading text or indicator. That is the seeded wait in which nothing says slots are on their way.

mapping.title: Single-choice day/slot/vehicle groups built as toggle buttons
mapping.reason: Screen-reader users hear independent pressed/unpressed toggles. They are not told only one can be chosen, and the other options unpress silently. Keyboard users must also tab through every one of up to 29 slot buttons instead of using arrow keys in one group. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Permit not validated on vehicle step; error only at booking
mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty or invalid permit, and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field. Both are in D07.

mapping.title: Booking-time error summary items have no link to fix them
mapping.reason: The central case is the confirm page's van permit error, which offers no way back to the permit field. D07 names this: the resident has to work out that 'Change vehicle' is the way back. The instructions put the confirm page's 'A van needs a permit number' under D07.

mapping.title: Today's unbookable slots shown as free and selectable
mapping.reason: Early slots today are offered as free and refused only at Book on the confirm page, after details are entered. This is exactly D06.

mapping.title: Second press of Book cancels the booking
mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s submission turns into 'Cancel booking' and saves the booking as cancelled. This is exactly D09.

mapping.title: Book button shows no sign of the 1.5 s submission
mapping.reason: Book stays unchanged during the 1.5 s wait, with no visible busy state. The instructions put 'Book doing nothing visible' under D09.

mapping.title: Five-minute hold never shown, warned about or extendable
mapping.reason: The 5-minute hold has no stated limit, countdown, warning or extension, and the slot is cleared when it lapses. That is D08.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag colours drift to low-contrast amber
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' amber text on amber tint is about 3.0:1 in light mode and 3.4:1 in dark, under the 4.5:1 needed. This is the seeded tag contrast failure.

mapping.title: Waste-limit hint referenced from a generic div
mapping.reason: By the item's own account, the limits are exposed in the checkbox names ('Rubble (up to four bags)', 'Mattresses (up to two)'), and the hint is read inside the group. Screen-reader users miss nothing, so no resident is hurt.

mapping.title: Vehicle-step error-summary links go to unfocusable containers
mapping.reason: Activating an error link drops focus to the body instead of the vehicle buttons or waste checkboxes, so screen-reader users are not taken to or told the field to fix. A genuine error-recovery barrier that is not seeded.

mapping.title: 'Few left' badge on a single slot has unclear meaning
mapping.reason: The page defines a slot as a 20-minute window to arrive in, which several residents can share, so 'Few left' (few places left in that window) follows naturally. The claim that residents read one slot as one booking has no basis in what the review shows, and the reply itself calls it something to test.

mapping.title: Vehicle step does not repeat the chosen day and time
mapping.reason: The flow repeats the choice on the check-and-book step, the standard pattern for multi-step forms. Not repeating it on the middle step is a matter of preference, with no shown harm to residents.

mapping.title: Permit field visible and unexplained after 'Car' is chosen
mapping.reason: The permit rule appears only behind the info button, the field does not say it is for vans and trailers, and Next proceeds with it empty. These are the permit-rule and permit-field problems of D07.

mapping.title: Permit field shown to every resident regardless of vehicle
mapping.reason: The field does not say it applies only to vans and trailers; that rule is only in the collapsed 'About vans and trailers' panel. Same permit-rule problem as D07.

mapping.title: Permit help behind an unlabelled info icon
mapping.reason: D07 states that the permit requirement is said only behind an icon-only info button. This item describes exactly that.

mapping.title: Permit help says 'apply on the council site' with no link
mapping.reason: Van and trailer owners are told to get a permit but given no link, page name or phone route. Those who need one cannot find out where to apply, and the permit takes two working days. Fixing D07 would not fix this; not seeded.

mapping.title: No change link for Waste on the confirm summary
mapping.reason: A resident who notices wrong waste on the check page has no visible way to correct it; that 'Change vehicle' also covers waste is not said. A minor but genuine error-correction gap, not seeded.

mapping.title: Returning to the slot page resets the day to Today
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' (and 'Back to the slots') open the first step on Today with no slot chosen, forgetting the picked day. This is D12.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking by reference
mapping.reason: Residents who cannot come can only phone on weekdays 09:00-17:00, though they book in the evening and the centre opens most days. So many cannot free or move their slot when they need to. Genuine and not seeded.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0078: changing a booking is a core task, but the only route is a weekday phone line, which fails residents who book in the evenings. Genuine, not seeded.

mapping.title: No page states how long a chosen slot is held
mapping.reason: The hold can expire but no page mentions a hold, a limit or a countdown. That is D08, the hold running out unseen.

mapping.title: Slot grid fixed at seven columns at 1280 px
mapping.reason: Spare width beside a full set of desktop slot columns is a cosmetic departure from the design document. Residents, who mostly book on phones, can still see and choose every slot, so this is a matter of taste.

mapping.title: Info button styled like a fourth vehicle option
mapping.reason: This is the icon-only permit-info button of D07, described from its styling. Because it reads as a vehicle option rather than help, residents miss the permit rule it holds, which is D07's harm. The not-segmented remark adds nothing beyond that.

mapping.title: axe colour-contrast failure on the 'Few left' tag
mapping.reason: #bd7d0f on #fbefda at 16 px bold measures 3.02:1, under 4.5:1. This is the seeded 'Few left' contrast defect (a tool finding).

mapping.title: No progress during the 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
mapping.reason: Choosing a trailer or van triggers a 1.2 s delay, with no progress shown, before the permit field is revealed. The instructions put the delayed permit field under D07 (a tool finding).

mapping.title: Layout shift above the 0.1 budget on /
mapping.reason: Lab CLS of 0.169, the largest shift moving #opening. This is the seeded jump when the slots arrive (a tool finding).
